title: Customer Service Administrator
description: Customer Service Administrator Our client, a dynamic player in the logistics and transportation sector, is seeking a motivated Customer Service Administrator to join their vibrant team in Stoke on Trent, ST1 area. This is a temporary-permanent position offering an exciting opportunity to enhance your career while providing outstanding service to customers. This role requires someone with a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences and a keen eye for detail. Key Responsibilities: - Process orders and maintain accurate client, stock, delivery, and back order records. - Produce, check and print product, carton, courier, and dispatch labels. - Monitor shared inboxes, respond to routine telephone, and email enquiries. - Record returns and refusals and escalate complaints or complex concerns. - Maintain spreadsheets, databases, and tracking systems. - Work closely with Customer Service, Warehouse and Operations colleagues. Ideal Candidate Profile: - Previous administration, customer service, order-processing or similar experience. - Good Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel skills. - The ability to prioritise work, meet deadlines and escalate concerns appropriately. - Experience using order-tracking, CRM, WMS, or label-printing systems is desirable. - Strong attention to detail and accuracy in work. - Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. - A positive attitude and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
